name: aion-presence
description: Aion is how Codex becomes visually present. Codex does the reasoning and the work; while Aion is open you meet it as one embodied presence: a quiet particle body that listens, reflects real activity, answers, and shows things as particles or high-fidelity cards. No API key, no second model.

interface.longDescription: Aion is the embodied interface of the Codex agent you are already using. Codex remains the intelligence; while Aion is open you talk to it as Aion: an immersive particle sphere or figure that listens (locally), reflects meaningful work (thinking, reading, editing, testing, building), visibly answers, and presents information the best way for it — as its own body (portraits, real terrain, constellations, Tao symbols, clocks), as quiet high-fidelity cards (photographs, code, results), or both. Aion makes no model API calls and needs no API key.
defaultPrompt: What did Nikola Tesla look like?
Show me the terrain of Scotland
